mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon (merchant_id, store_id, name, description, discount_text, valid_from, valid_to, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{storeId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{discountText}, #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon SET name=#{name}, description=#{description}, discount_text=#{discountText}, valid_from=#{validFrom}, valid_to=#{validTo}, status=#{status}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, merchant_id, store_id, name, description, discount_text, valid_from, valid_to, status, created_at, updated_at FROM coupon WHERE id=#{id}
